# ML-11: Efficient ML and Model Optimization (Tier 2)

**Subtrack:** Machine Learning Engineering  
**Unit scope:** Profiling, quantisation, pruning, distillation, ONNX export and latency/memory budgets on CPU hardware.

**Tier note:** Tier 1 is not offered. Optimisation presupposes a working, evaluated model and a profiling mindset, both of which are Tier 2 competencies.
